# Cncf Kubearmor Reviewer

Review KubeArmor using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Runtime protection for Kubernetes &amp; other cloud Workloads. Kubearmor provides a observability and policy enforcement system to restrict any unwanted, malicious behaviour of cloud-native workloads at runtime.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
